title: ChArUcoRenderOptions
description: Specifies how a ChArUco board should be rendered into an image (PNG, PDF, SVG, etc.) suitable for display or printing. Orthogonal to ChArUcoBoard so the same board can be rendered at multiple sizes/resolutions.

image_width.description: Width of the generated image in pixels.

image_height.description: Height of the generated image in pixels.

margin_size.description: White border around the board, measured in pixels.

border_bits.description: Width of the black border surrounding each ArUco marker, expressed in marker cells.

dpi.description: Target print resolution in dots per inch.
